Thirty languages and the journey of a poem · Kabita Live

notes: Current existing public builds measured, with artifact hashes and dirty-source revisions; no source rebuild performed.
These are laboratory observations of local uncompressed static delivery with CPU/network throttle settings requested through CDP; not production Core Web Vitals or real-user results.
Requested network latency is not treated as a verified effective localhost latency; observed navigation response timings are retained.
Paint/LCP/CLS values cover the observation window, not a complete session. A zero load event means loading had not completed when sampled; no final load time is inferred.
External HTTPS provider requests blocked; Analytics/Firebase live behavior and external media delivery are not measured.
Free to Dream and Utkal do not yet implement the common reader; poem/collection-entry baselines cover their future entry paths without claiming reader mode.
Three initial Kabita reader samples used an unsupported parameter and are excluded from the summary; corrected focus=1 samples use a documented 20-second window.
